description: This file defines the internal sealed class SiloConnectionFactory, which extends ConnectionFactory, responsible for creating and managing silo connections within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for establishing connections, configuring connection builders, and ensuring proper initialization of dependencies.

classes.name: SiloConnectionFactory
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for creating and managing silo connections in Orleans, extending ConnectionFactory.

methods.name: SiloConnectionFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and base class with required services and options.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Establishes an asynchronous connection to a specified silo address, with a check for dead silos.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates a new SiloConnection instance with the provided address and connection context.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures the connection builder with silo-specific outbound settings.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that internal dependencies are initialized in a thread-safe manner.
